title: Settings
newProgrammeMeta: Start again from your profile and equipment
aboutLocal: Your data stays on this phone. No account, no server.

newDialog.title: Start a new programme?
newDialog.text: We generate one from your current profile and equipment. You’ll see what changes before it replaces the one in progress.

profilePage.goalHint: Changing it needs a new programme.
profilePage.scheduleHint: Changing sessions a week needs a new programme.
profilePage.bodyweightNote: Used for starting loads in your next programme.
profilePage.outdated: Saving marks your current programme as out of date. You choose when to update it.
profilePage.needsNew: Changing the goal or sessions a week needs a new programme.
profilePage.saved: Profile saved. Your programme is out of date.
profilePage.newDialogGoal: With a new goal, sets, reps and rest change. You’ll see what changes before it replaces your current programme.
profilePage.newDialogDays: With {{days}} sessions a week the split changes. You’ll see what changes before it replaces your current programme.
profilePage.newDialogBoth: With a new goal and {{days}} sessions a week the programme changes. You’ll see what changes before it replaces your current programme.
profilePage.leaveText: Your profile changes will be lost.

during.title: During a workout
during.voiceMeta: Exercise, reps and load at each set
during.soundsMeta: End of rest and the last 3 seconds

data.title: Data and backup
data.exportJsonHint: One .json file with everything. It’s the file you can restore from.
data.exportCsvHint: One row per set, for a spreadsheet. It can’t be imported back.
data.storage_grantedMeta: The browser won’t clear your data to free up space.
data.storage_refusedMeta: The browser may clear your data if the phone runs short of space. Keep a recent backup.
data.storage_unknownMeta: This browser can’t say whether your data is kept. Keep a recent backup.
data.storageHint: Adding the app to your home screen often gets it granted.
data.importHint: Replaces everything on this phone with a backup. Your current data is downloaded just before.

import.title: Import a backup
import.newer_one: The {{count}} session you did after this backup will be replaced. It stays in the copy downloaded before the import.
import.newer_other: The {{count}} sessions you did after this backup will be replaced. They stay in the copy downloaded before the import.
import.confirmText: This phone goes back to the backup from {{date}}. Just before, a copy of your current data is downloaded.
import.confirmOpen: The session in progress is replaced too.
import.busyCopy: Downloading a copy of your current data…
import.doneCopy: Your previous data is in your downloads: {{file}}
import.error_not-a-backupText: Pick a .json file exported from Data and backup. Nothing was changed.
import.error_invalidText: Some of its content can’t be read. Try another copy of the backup. Nothing was changed.
import.error_newer-version: Backup made with a newer version
import.error_newer-versionText: This version of the app can’t read it yet. Close the app and open it again to update, then try again. Nothing was changed.
import.error_copy-failedText: Without that copy nothing is replaced. Try again, or export a backup first. Nothing was changed.

reminder.title: Back up your data
reminder.age_one: Your last backup is {{count}} day old. Everything lives on this phone and nowhere else.
reminder.age_other: Your last backup is {{count}} days old. Everything lives on this phone and nowhere else.
reminder.never: You haven’t made a backup yet. Everything lives on this phone and nowhere else.
reminder.firmAge_one: This browser hasn’t granted lasting storage, and your last backup is {{count}} day old. Export one now.
reminder.firmAge_other: This browser hasn’t granted lasting storage, and your last backup is {{count}} days old. Export one now.
reminder.firmNever: This browser hasn’t granted lasting storage, and you haven’t made a backup yet. Export one now.
